environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed behind AWS API Gateway (HTTP API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /api/v2/cache/hydrate route. The validator enforces a JSON Schema model where 'payload' field must match pattern '^[A-Za-z0-9+/=]{1,2048}$' AND the schema requires 'payload' to have a maxLength of 2048 bytes. Additionally, the API Gateway integration uses a VPC Link with request body passthrough mode set to 'WHEN_NO_MATCH' (meaning only schema-valid requests reach the backend). The JSON Schema also enforces that 'key' must be a string matching '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$' and 'ttl' must be an integer between 1 and 86400. Note: the API Gateway request validator performs structural validation only — it does not inspect the semantic content of base64 payloads. The gateway runs in us-east-1 with CloudWatch logging enabled on the stage.
